title: Physics papers to watch — arXiv batch, Friday 9 October 2026
global_caveat: arXiv has no official trending chart. This inferred editorial ranking is not a readership list; the papers are newly announced and comparable citation or independent-attention evidence is sparse.

sections.title: HI intensity mapping with MeerKAT: A measurement of the 21-cm auto-spectrum on cosmological scales
sections.abstract: MeerKLASS researchers report a 6.2-signal-to-noise measurement of neutral hydrogen’s 21-cm auto-spectrum at redshift 0.42 using MeerKAT intensity maps.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report an HI auto-spectrum detection at 6.2σ and measure 10³ Ω_HI b_HI = 1.271(+1.080/−0.598) from MeerKLASS 2021 observations.
sections.evidence_type: Observational; 64-antenna MeerKAT single-dish maps over about 236 deg², analysed using internal cross-spectra.
sections.unique_caveat: Subset auto-spectra contain excess power attributed to unresolved systematics; the result is recovered using cross-spectra and a model that marginalizes possible signal loss.

sections.title: Observation of single top-quark production in the s-channel in proton–proton collisions at √s = 13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
sections.abstract: ATLAS reports the first single-experiment observation of s-channel single-top production, using 13-TeV proton collisions and a neural-network-based event separation.
sections.claimed_result: From 140 fb⁻¹ of ATLAS data, the authors measure a cross-section of 10.8 ± 1.5 (stat.) ± 1.6 (syst.) pb, consistent with the Standard Model, with 5.1σ observed significance.
sections.evidence_type: Experimental; ATLAS 13-TeV collision data, classified using a graph neural network and likelihood fit.
sections.unique_caveat: This is one experiment’s analysis of one production channel; the result is consistent with the Standard Model and is not evidence for new physics.

sections.title: Evidence for Normal Neutrino Ordering with Combined Atmospheric Neutrino Experiments
sections.abstract: The authors combine public atmospheric-neutrino data from Super-Kamiokande, IceCube-DeepCore and KM3NeT/ORCA6, finding a preference for normal mass ordering.
sections.claimed_result: The paper reports a 3.3σ preference for normal ordering (99.95% confidence against inverted ordering after calibration), plus atmospheric oscillation constraints competitive with accelerator measurements.
sections.evidence_type: Experimental-data analysis; public Super-Kamiokande, IceCube-DeepCore and six-unit KM3NeT/ORCA samples.
sections.unique_caveat: The ordering preference is evidence, not a discovery; the fit uses currently available datasets, including early ORCA6 data, and depends on treatment of shared flux and cross-section uncertainties.

sections.title: Femtosecond Three-Dimensional Imaging of Single-Protein with Hard X-ray Laser
sections.abstract: The team uses hard-X-ray free-electron-laser pulses to reconstruct two- and three-dimensional diffraction images of single erythrocruorin molecular complexes.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report 2D diffraction classes reconstructed to 15 Å and 3D images to about 20 Å for the erythrocruorin complex.
sections.evidence_type: Experimental; single-particle diffraction from hard-X-ray free-electron-laser pulses, with computational reconstruction.
sections.unique_caveat: The 3D resolution is lower than the 2D result; the authors suggest gas-phase compaction and sample heterogeneity as a likely cause. This is not an atomic-resolution structure.

sections.title: Discovery of Hidden Extragalactic Pulsars in the Parkes Archival Data
sections.abstract: Reprocessing Parkes Magellanic-Cloud survey archives with deeper harmonic searches yields six pulsars, including five in the Large Magellanic Cloud.
sections.claimed_result: The authors add five LMC pulsars to the known population, bringing it to 49; the sixth signal is a Milky Way foreground pulsar toward the SMC.
sections.evidence_type: Observational; reanalysis of archival Parkes Multibeam Magellanic-Cloud survey data.
sections.unique_caveat: Some low-flux variability cannot yet be distinguished between intrinsic nulling and scintillation, so the current sample cannot establish a reliable LMC nulling fraction.

sections.title: First demonstration of 50 ps four-dimensional vertex reconstruction with the Timepix4 beam telescope
sections.abstract: A CERN SPS beam test demonstrates joint spatial-and-time vertex reconstruction using a silicon-pixel telescope.
sections.claimed_result: With 16 timing-plane clusters, the authors reconstruct vertices at 54 ± 5 ps; their fitted model includes a 29.2 ± 0.6 ps irreducible component.
sections.evidence_type: Experimental; 180 GeV/c mixed-hadron beam on a fixed target at the CERN SPS, measured with the Timepix4 telescope.
sections.unique_caveat: The irreducible component includes substantial contributions from the clock distribution and time-reference system; this is a beam-test demonstration, not a collider-data result.

sections.title: Cavity Characterization for the Princeton Axion Search
sections.abstract: The Princeton Axion Search team measures and models a tunable haloscope cavity, validating its mode structure and quality factor for planned sub-μeV axion searches.
sections.claimed_result: Bead-perturbation measurements agree with simulations for the cavity’s TM010 mode, and the authors estimate the form-factor uncertainty across its tuning range.
sections.evidence_type: Experimental characterization; cavity measurements combined with electromagnetic simulations.
sections.unique_caveat: This is a hardware-characterization and readiness study, not an axion detection; the initial operating range is narrower than the full target mass window.

sections.title: Compressional heating above 1 keV on the LM26 magnetized target fusion machine
sections.abstract: The LM26 team reports keV-scale electron heating during compression of a magnetized plasma inside a lithium liner.
sections.claimed_result: Filtered X-ray diodes give a peak electron temperature of 1180 ± 65 eV, supported by adjacent Thomson scattering at 1090 ± 40 eV; neutron yield is used to infer ion temperature.
sections.evidence_type: Experimental; LM26 machine diagnostics including filtered X-ray diodes, Thomson scattering and neutron yield.
sections.unique_caveat: This is a plasma-heating result, not a claim of ignition, net energy gain or practical fusion power.
